## Predrag Milutinović, Dipl.Ing.Arch

Project management/Design managemet/Design Leadership

### PROFFESION

Architect, M.Eng.

### EXPERIENCE

July 2002,over 14 years of professional experience, and corporate experience in different industries (design management,design,construction)

### QUALIFICATIONS

M.Eng, Faculty of Architecture, University of Belgrade

### M.Eng, Faculty of Architecture, University of Belgrade

Membership in Chamber of Engineers of Serbia, Professional Engineering License no. 300 B972 05 DAB (Belgrade Association of Arch.), SAS (Serbian Association of Arch.),UIA, ISoCaRP , CCEE, Member of national Association of consulting Engineers of Serbia (ACES)

### PROFESSIONAL AWARDS

The city of Belgrade award for architecture and urban planning, Best realisation award given by Novosti (Borba), Best realisation award given by DaNS, Best interior design award given by Saint Gobain

### KEY DATA

Predrag Milutinović is an Architect, field of activity, Design, Consulting, Project Management, Design management. Responsible for designing processes and building engineering project management, projects development and implementation.

Has dynamic 13 years career with leading regional designing and civil construction companies throughout Ex YU - Serbia, Croatia, Makedonia, Montenegro and Bulgaria and Albania.

Has a thorough knowledge of design, led numerous projects and received prestigious awards as the author of architecture for some. Passed through all the stages of design and construction phases, throughout which he has developed its own skills. Has started as a PM - participated and led all the phases of the design and construction processes, and also designed ''know how'' concepts for many different types of objects/ projects.

Was responsible for design and delivery of projects such as hotels, supermarkets, industry, micro facilities, shopping malls, shopping parks, office buildings, car showrooms, major retail, mixed use, residential schemes, children's institutions.

Has extensive experience of the delivery of projects under framework agreements for clients such as IHG, BMW, HONDA, Delhaize, Generali, H&M, Bauhaus, NIKE.

Has thorough knowledge of construction and site development activities – from design to implementation and evaluation. Knowledge of construction project plan requirements, specification writing, building/site codes and standards and inspection techniques, knowledge of financial procedures to maintain project cost control.

Has reporting, project management, planning and contractual skills, business acumen, estimating, budget establishment and control, quality assurance, control and safety management set up and implementation knowledge.

Has a strong team leadership spirit, but also the ability to work as an individual if necessary, communicational, organizational and people skills.
